numeric_consistency.question: do the numbers the claim reports reproduce from the archived artifacts/JSON those numbers cite?

eligibility.question: are the source files AND the raw per-instance trajectories still present, so the claim is replayable from raw data?

statistical_support.question: is the claim backed by a paired instance-level interval excluding zero under the registered multiplicity/alpha discipline?

generalization_scope.question: is the claim scoped to the configurations/cohorts actually measured, and does the text avoid universal wording (impossibility, equivalence, "never", "proved", "唯一")?

overall_verdict_definitions.claim_excess_upheld: the documents assert the claim and at least one dimension fails

overall_verdict_definitions.not_asserted_in_audited_documents: no audited document asserts the claim
overall_verdict_definitions.indeterminate_input_missing: a required input is missing, so support is indeterminate

confirmation_family_preregistered_cohort.note: the two D-ANYTIME-v1 cohorts are marked not_a_preregistered_test=true by the panel that produced the comparison; only the third cohort declares preregistered_primary=true. A preregistration marker is a stored literal, not proof of registration time.

pruned_and_clean_status_missing_input.definition: a pruned/clean status passes only when the documents searched for claim excesses are present AND every artifact the pruning cites is present and readable; a missing input is a failure, never a pass

cross_cohort_percentage_comparisons.definition: the programme's own adopted rule (WORK_STATUS delivery.n15 rule_within_cohort_comparison): percentage differences may be compared ONLY within the same cohort. A line is flagged when it carries >=2 percentage values, a comparison cue, and either two distinct named cohorts or a plural-cohort phrase; correction, withdrawal and 'confirmation not run' lines are excluded
cross_cohort_percentage_comparisons.caveat: this is a lexical scan over narrative documents; every flag is shown with its line so it can be judged, and a flag is a rule violation under the adopted within-cohort rule rather than a new scientific claim excess

documented_excess_locations.note: presence of the disposition document is fail-closed; the specific trigger-to-reason mapping it records is advisory because the file is prose and its table is read lexically

scientific_support.claim_excesses_note: exactly the v1 detection set, in v1 order and wording; new findings are reported in additional_findings so this list stays comparable with earlier archived audits
scientific_support.pickup_tail_objective_scope: A-v1 utility headroom (energy and quality not re-simulated)

dynamic_suffix_screen.limited_to: same loaded cargo, same ownership, deterministic nearest-neighbour suffix recomputation
does_not_exclude: other suffix searches or MaskCO reconstructions
dynamic_suffix_screen.logical_note: A deterministic nearest-neighbour sequence retains the same successor choices after its executed prefix is removed, when no input geometry/cargo changes; its zero recourse effect is not an action-set upper bound.

scientific_support.why_no_impossibility: A feasible greedy full-information policy is a lower bound on an optimum; a null or worse result cannot close policies or action sets.
scientific_support.why_no_learning_bound: Finite nonlearned masking heuristics do not upper-bound learned policies; worse downstream objective is not a measured representation correlation.
open_paths_nonexhaustive: learned or adaptive mask with equal decoder overhead control
true dynamic delivery lifecycle and qualified strong rolling control

limitations: No new numerical experiment or original audit script executed.
Headline values and CIs were read, not reconstructed here from raw trajectories.
Literal registered_before_data flags do not prove registration time or immutable pre-data closure.
Eligibility reports whether raw inputs exist on disk; it does not replay them.
The cross-cohort and universal-wording scans are lexical over narrative documents and show every hit with its line for judgement.
Even four passing dimensions cannot substitute for independent executed-cohort replay and main/attribution tests.
A missing input is always reported as a failure and never as a clean result.
